defect.reproducer: Publish Twist with linear.x=1.0 and angular.z=0.5 at 1 Hz to /cmd_vel using --wait-matching-subscriptions 0. topic info shows 1 publisher and 0 subscribers; pose remains x=6.509308815002441, y=5.796990871429443, theta=0.5040000081062317.
defect.root_cause: turtlesim subscribes to /turtle1/cmd_vel, which is a different fully qualified topic name. The matching message type and discovered publisher alone do not provide delivery. ROS_DOMAIN_ID=16, message values and rate are unchanged.
defect.proof_after: Change only /cmd_vel to /turtle1/cmd_vel. topic info shows 1 publisher and 1 subscriber (turtlesim); pose during motion is x=5.779031753540039, y=9.529672622680664, theta=3.0160000324249268 with linear_velocity=1.0 and angular_velocity=0.5. After stopping the publisher both velocities return to 0.0.
